title: Ennyingiza Okuva Mu Kukozesebwa - Ekitongole ekivunaanyizibwa ku musolo mu Uganda
text:
| Ennyingiza (Omusaala) buli mwezi | Omuwendogwómusolo |
| --- | --- |
| Bw’oba toyingiza ssente zisukka mu Ushs. 235,000 | Toggibwako musolo gwonna |
| Bw’oba ofuna Ushs. 235,000 nga tosukka Ushs. 335,000 | Ebitundu kkumi ku buli kukumi (10%) eby’omuwendo ogusukka mu Shs. 235,000. |
| Bw’oba ofuna Ushs. 335,000 nga tosukka Ushs. 410,000 | Omutwalo gumu (10,000) n’ogattako n’ebitundu abiri ku buli kikumi (20%) ky’omuwendo ogusukka mu Ushs. 335,000 |
| Okusukka mu Ushs. 410,000 | (a)  Ushs. 25,000 n’ogattako ebitundu asatu ku buli kikumi (30%) eky’omuwendo ogusukka mu Ushs. 410,000. Ne (b)  Omusaala gw’omuntu bwe guba nga gusukka mu bukadde ekkumi (10,000,000), ennyongereza y’ebitundu kkumi ku buli kikumi (10%) ky’omuwendo omusaala kyegusoba mu bukadde ekkumi (10,000,000) |

rows: Bw’oba toyingiza ssente zisukka mu Ushs. 235,000
Bw’oba ofuna Ushs. 235,000 nga tosukka Ushs. 335,000
Ebitundu kkumi ku buli kukumi (10%) eby’omuwendo ogusukka mu Shs. 235,000.
Bw’oba ofuna Ushs. 335,000 nga tosukka Ushs. 410,000
Omutwalo gumu (10,000) n’ogattako n’ebitundu abiri ku buli kikumi (20%) ky’omuwendo ogusukka mu Ushs. 335,000

(a)  Ushs. 25,000 n’ogattako ebitundu asatu ku buli kikumi (30%) eky’omuwendo ogusukka mu Ushs. 410,000. Ne (b)  Omusaala gw’omuntu bwe guba nga gusukka mu bukadde ekkumi (10,000,000), ennyongereza y’ebitundu kkumi ku buli kikumi (10%) ky’omuwendo omusaala kyegusoba mu bukadde ekkumi (10,000,000)
